heading: Thursday, July 9, 2026
topLine: Meta releases Muse Spark 1.1 and opens the Meta Model API.

items.headline: Meta releases Muse Spark 1.1 and opens the Meta Model API
items.summary: Muse Spark 1.1 is a multimodal reasoning model aimed at agentic tasks, with a 1M-token context and improved tool use, computer use and coding, according to Meta. It launched with a public preview of the paid, OpenAI-compatible Meta Model API and in the Thinking mode of Meta AI.
